headline.en: See the next issue to fix before sharing an app.
headline.zh: 分享应用前，看清下一处要修的问题。

sub.en: VibeGate combines a static project check, license-policy findings and a startup run into a bilingual red/yellow/green report with concrete next-step hints.
sub.zh: VibeGate 将静态项目检查、许可证策略问题与启动运行汇总为中英双语红黄绿报告，并给出具体修复提示。

body.en: Readiness, license and startup retain their own results.
body.zh: 就绪、许可证与启动保留各自结果。
问题带有双语修复提示。

body.en: JSON exposes the same checks as the terminal view.
body.zh: JSON 与终端视图暴露同一检查结果。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Node.js 20+; the demo creates its own complete app without dependencies, so the two startup checks need no registry access.
note.zh: 需要 Node.js 20+；示例创建自身完整无依赖应用，两次启动检查均无需访问包仓库。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Three production checks on a complete temporary dependency-free app before/after adding a README and correcting its startup exit. Child code only exits with a fixed status.

body.en: Node.js 20+; the demo creates its own complete app without dependencies, so the two startup checks need no registry access.
body.zh: 需要 Node.js 20+；示例创建自身完整无依赖应用，两次启动检查均无需访问包仓库。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/vibegate.git
cd vibegate
npm ci
npm run build

limitations.en: The temporary directory and reduced environment are not an OS security sandbox. A full run can install dependencies and execute project scripts with host access; inspect unfamiliar projects first.
limitations.zh: 临时目录与精简环境不是操作系统安全沙箱。完整运行可能安装依赖并执行具有主机访问权限的项目脚本；先检查不熟悉的项目。

limitations.en: A green report covers only the checks performed, not deployment readiness, legal clearance or absence of vulnerabilities. License labels are configurable review signals.
limitations.zh: 绿灯只覆盖已运行的检查，不代表部署就绪、法律许可或无漏洞。许可证标签是可配置的审阅信号。

limitations.en: Red/yellow findings do not currently set a failing CLI exit by themselves. Inspect report.verdict for automation. Long-running servers may hit the timeout even when functioning, and mini-program startup is skipped.
limitations.zh: 红/黄问题本身目前不会让 CLI 非零退出；自动化应检查 report.verdict。长运行服务即使正常也可能超时，小程序启动会跳过。

body.en: A project may run in a developer’s shell while missing a README, relying on local configuration or failing a fresh start. Separate checks show which of those conditions needs attention.
body.zh: 项目在开发者 Shell 中能跑，也可能缺 README、依赖本地配置或无法重新启动。分项检查能指出究竟是哪类条件需要处理。

body.en: The CLI detects runtime markers and loads .vibegate.yml. Readiness and license scanners collect findings. The startup path copies the project to a temporary directory, installs dependencies when present and runs its start command with a reduced environment and timeout. The report takes the worst check status.
body.zh: CLI 识别运行时标记并加载 .vibegate.yml；readiness 与 license 扫描器收集问题。启动路径把项目复制到临时目录，有依赖时安装，再用精简环境和超时运行 start 命令；报告取最严重的检查状态。

body.en: The CLI detects runtime markers and loads .vibegate.yml. Readiness and license scanners collect findings. The startup path copies the project to a temporary directory, installs dependencies when present and runs its start command with a reduced environment and timeout. The report takes the worst check status.
body.zh: CLI 识别运行时标记并加载 .vibegate.yml；readiness 与 license 扫描器收集问题。启动路径把项目复制到临时目录，有依赖时安装，再用精简环境和超时运行 start 命令；报告取最严重的检查状态。

body.en: Choose the input and output route that matches your workflow. The local example below exercises the stated subset.
body.zh: 根据工作流选择输入与输出路径。本文本地示例验证其中明确说明的子流程。

body.en: .vibegate.yml sets timeoutMs (30000 by default), copyleftAllowlist, extraSecretPatterns and writeReport. --timeout overrides startup timeout; --no-json disables report writing. scan performs static checks; run performs startup only; a bare path performs all three. Reports normally go to the project as vibegate-report.json; a read-only project can cause a home-directory fallback. Tests and common build directories are excluded from static production-source scans.
body.zh: .vibegate.yml 可配置 timeoutMs（默认 30000）、copyleftAllowlist、extraSecretPatterns、writeReport。--timeout 覆盖启动超时，--no-json 禁止写报告。scan 只做静态检查，run 只做启动，直接传路径则运行三项。报告通常写到项目 vibegate-report.json，项目只读时可能回退到用户目录。静态生产源码扫描排除测试与常见构建目录。

body.en: Run these commands from the repository root after installation. Replace paths for your own data.
body.zh: 安装后在仓库根目录运行以下命令；处理自己的数据时替换相应路径。

details.code:
node dist/cli.js scan examples/demo-app --no-json
node dist/cli.js run examples/demo-app --timeout 3000 --no-json
# Run all checks on a project you trust:
node dist/cli.js examples/demo-app --timeout 3000
